programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.

programme.title: Superbeast 1 #3
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: 超獸 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.

programme.title: Superbeast 1 #4
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: 超獸 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit 1 #5
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.

programme.title: Lifes Journey 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along t...

programme.title: 生命之旅 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線.牠們成年的過程需要技巧、力量、勇氣和大量的運氣.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #1
programme.desc: 探索美麗的海德堡城堡,它的廢墟屹立在德國西部的內卡河旁.這座城堡位於受保護的自然保育區中,是猛禽的家園,亦是附近兩棲類的產卵場.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 #2
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of historys greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #2
programme.desc: 前往擁有數百年歷史的法國堡壘,它是史上一些最偉大帝國的家園.卡爾卡松曾是財富和文化的中心,如今已成為野生動物的避難所.鳥類、野豬和昆蟲大軍在其豐裕的環境中生存.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 #3
programme.desc: Discover the worlds largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #3
programme.desc: 發掘刻在洞穴裡世上最大的城堡.斯洛文尼亞的洞窟城堡不僅為中世紀的人類居民提供了保護,而且還為該區的鳥類、野豬和野山羊提供了避難所.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 #4
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spains Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the regions wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #4
programme.desc: 遊覽西班牙格林納達地區一生必到的非凡堡壘- 阿爾罕布拉宮.這個世界文化遺產現在成了該地區野生動植物的庇護所.它擁有眾多溪流和噴泉,可供應兩棲類、魚類和鳥類.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 #5
programme.desc: Learn how one of the worlds most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #5
programme.desc: 瞭解世上最壯觀的建築之一 - 新天鵝堡及其周邊的森林如何成為許多生物的家園.從阿爾卑斯羱羊到雄偉的天鵝,這座城堡於數世紀以來成了天然避難所.

programme.title: Americas Wild Border: Northern Exposure [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 [英/普]
programme.desc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界.動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄.

programme.title: Planet Shark 1 #1
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵.觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物.

programme.title: Planet Shark 1 #2
programme.desc: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #2
programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊、深邃與黑暗.見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊.

programme.title: Planet Shark 1 #3
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.

programme.title: Wild Latin America 1 #1
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.

programme.title: Wild Latin America 1 #2
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuletas loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜.在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼.並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

programme.title: Into the Wild India 1 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 [英/普]
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains 1 #2 [Eng/Man]

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit 1 #6
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Livs hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇.傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速、驚慌不已.

programme.title: Lifes Journey 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animals legacy. But its not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest ...

programme.title: 生命之旅 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 為了把基因傳承給下一代,動物在一生中歷盡史詩式的鬥爭.只有最強壯和最有決心的才能覓得伴侶,為交配而戰,也只有最優秀的父母才能擁有讓幼崽存活的技能.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand 1 #1
programme.desc: At the waters edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. Its time to breed and they ...

programme.title: 野性之最紐西蘭 #1
programme.desc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鵝聚集在水邊,準備在岸上進行危險的旅程.面對前路的險途,數量多比較安全.這些小企鵝有著重要的任務,繁殖的時候到了,牠們必須在雌性到來前找到一個洞穴.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand 1 #2
programme.desc: New Zealands West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wildernes...

programme.title: 野性之最紐西蘭 #2
programme.desc: 紐西蘭的西岸不像世上任何地方.從冰川覆蓋的山脈到原始雨林,再到嚴酷的寒冷海域,壯麗景致令人難以置信.這片與世隔絕幾乎未被觸及的桃花園,隱藏著許多土生的動物.進化的漂流者,每一個都是罕見的生態瑰寶.從啄羊鸚鵡和害羞的企鵝到哺乳類般的鷸鴕和古老的鰻魚,為了於這種條件下生存,這裡的野生動物必須堅強,...

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand 1 #3
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries an...

programme.title: 野性之最紐西蘭 #3
programme.desc: 紐西蘭有兩個野生堡壘保護脆弱的土生動物:一個是受到鹽水護城河保護的偏遠島嶼,另一個是被防捕食者屏障包圍的山頂城堡.這是這些精緻的庇護所和在其中茁壯成長的動物的故事.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand 1 #4
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealands east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. Theyve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives diffi...

programme.title: 野性之最紐西蘭 #4
programme.desc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光.牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖.但因惡劣的地形、無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難.只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand 1 #5
programme.desc: New Zealands isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Li...

programme.title: 野性之最紐西蘭 #5
programme.desc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名.尤以不會飛的鳥類、古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界.這裡有微型的怪物、小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命.每個獵人也是獵物﹐永遠需要努力生存.走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活.從巨...

programme.title: Alaskan Summer [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to Augus...

programme.title: 阿拉斯加的夏天 [英/普]
programme.desc: 《阿拉斯加的夏天》以令人驚嘆的高動態範圍成像方法拍攝,展現了美國最北部州份充滿活力的雄偉景緻.從令人驚嘆的小灣、海灣和水灣所展示巴拉諾夫島的崎嶇之美,到座頭鯨和虎鯨在參天的冰川和高聳的山脈間那平靜的水域中暢遊的冰川灣,這是阿拉斯加與眾不同的旅程.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue 1 #6
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the teams plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 阿曼達和文迪施展渾身解數來幫助一頭被捕網抓獲的鬣狗; 一頭獅子威脅村莊; 團隊釋放13隻猴子的計劃因最後一刻的手術而受阻;還有一些狡猾的逃生藝術家.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks 1 #1
programme.desc: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse m...

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #1
programme.desc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚、魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園.這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks 1 #2
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #2
programme.desc: 佛羅里達群島是美國南部的第一道防線.憑藉豐富的海軍歷史和沿海生活方式,不難相信當地人聲稱那是多達1000艘沉船殘骸的家.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks 1 #3
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #3
programme.desc: 巴哈馬被稱為水底電影世界的首都.荷里活已經到訪這裡幾十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底製作史詩式的電影和電視戲劇節目,其中的大熱景點包括許多電影般的沉船.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks 1 #4
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #4
programme.desc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場、高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
programme.desc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
programme.desc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
programme.desc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?

programme.title: In for the Kill [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: 致命奇襲 [英/普]
programme.desc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度、狡猾和敏捷?

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場、高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons 2 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
programme.desc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
programme.desc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution 1 #1
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #1
programme.desc: 您曾否想過為何山魈的臉如此七彩,禿鷹為何禿頭,甚至雙髻鯊為何有雙髻?發掘動物如何通過脖子以上的進化來生存.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

programme.title: Superbeast 1 #3
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: 超獸 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.

programme.title: Superbeast 1 #4
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: 超獸 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.

programme.title: Wild Latin America 1 #3
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks 1 #5
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #5
programme.desc: 從機會主義的海盜船到裝備精良的海軍艦艇,墨西哥的尤卡坦半島沉浸在海事的歷史中.

programme.title: Guillaume's French Atlantic[Eng]
programme.desc: Guillaume takes viewers on a captivating journey through his ancestral home of Brittany. From the bustling scallop festival in Erquy to the historic walled city of Saint Malo, he explores the customs and cuisine that have left an indelible mark on his culinary journey. Witness the artistry of fresh scallop sashimi and savour the exquisite flavours of a sweet rice pudding with salted caramel.

programme.title: 法國西岸滋味遊[英]
programme.desc: 紀爾恩巴林希米帶觀眾遊歷他的故鄉布列塔尼。從埃爾基的熱鬧扇貝節，到歷史悠久的城牆之城聖馬洛，不但可看到他探索在其烹飪中留痕的習俗與菜式，還有他炮製的新鮮扇貝刺身，以及加了有鹽焦糖的香甜米布甸。

programme.title: DownieLive Travels by Train[Eng]
programme.desc: Mike and Will arrive in the last province, British Columbia. Last week, the final leg of the train was canceled due to extreme weather. They have to take the plane to BC, where they paddle with their family and learn more about the history and culture of the Tsleil-Waututh first nation. And they grab the chance to ice-skate. But will they complete the journey with the train?

programme.title: 貼地鐵路遊[英]
programme.desc: 今集，米高和韋爾來到最後一站：卑詩省。最後一段火車因極端天氣被取消，他們要坐飛機到卑詩省。他們跟親友一起划船，認識特斯利-沃圖原住民的歷史和文化，還把握機會在溫哥華溜冰。他們最後能否坐火車完成旅程？

programme.title: Pearl Magazine[Eng]
programme.desc: Ethnic minority or non-Chinese speaking families in Hong Kong wish their next generation to master Chinese integrate into the society to have a better chance of success. Choosing a school can therefore become a defining decision. But do they really have agency to make their own choice?

programme.title: Castles from Above[Eng]
programme.desc: From palaces designed to amaze to medieval fortresses, the castles of the Czech Republic have much more to tell than simple stories of the past. They are witness to the power, culture and evolution of a country that was immersed in a global empire in central Europe for centuries. In this episode, we will fly over Hluboka, Orlik, Konopiste, Karlstejn, Kryvoklat, Kost, Sovinec, Bouzov, Pernstjn and Lednice Palace.

programme.title: 穹蒼下的城堡[英]
programme.desc: 捷克數百年來都是歐洲中部一個全球帝國的一部分，從令人眩目的萊德尼采到中世紀的布佐夫，這些城堡不只述說舊事，還見證國家權力、文化與發展。今集會飛越赫盧博卡、奧爾利克等堡壘，欣賞這些歷史悠久的壯麗建築。

programme.title: MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.desc: Michelin chef Curtis Stone joins our Top 10 for a team service challenge. The contestants are split into 2 teams and have to cook a 2-course meal with a feature root vegetable for 24 guests. The team with the best overall menu will go straight into the next immunity challenge. However, the judges are worried that the contestants are playing it safe and don't have a clear idea from the beginning.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
programme.desc: 米芝蓮大廚寇蒂斯史東跟十強一起進行團隊出菜挑戰。參賽者分為兩隊，要選一種根菜炮製一個包括兩種菜式的套餐。勝方可以直入下場重要的豁免賽，但評判擔心他們的策略過於保守，也未能從一開始就有清晰想法。

programme.title: MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.desc: Curtis Stone returns to present Adi, Rue, Ralph, Rhiannon, and Brent with a 2-round immunity challenge. In Round 1, they create their very own condiment for the judges, and the top 3 move on to Round 2. In Round 2, they have 75 minutes to pair the condiments with the perfect dish. The winner of Round 2 wins not only immunity from the next elimination, but also a life-changing prize.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
programme.desc: 寇蒂斯史東回到廚神廚房主持兩回合的豁免賽。在第一回合他們要炮製獨特的調味汁，當中三甲可進入第二回合，在75分鐘內做出最適合搭配該調味汁的菜式。勝利者不但可贏得豁免權，更可獲得改變人生的大獎。

programme.title: Dog's Best Friend[Eng]
programme.desc: At the Everglades Holiday Park Animal Rescue in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, Rose, a fox and Bindi, a raccoon, love to play together and stirring up loads of mischief! A Doberman puppy and a rescued Coatimundi play together like besties and even get time outs when it gets a bit too rough!

programme.title: 2026年王者榮耀KPL年度總決賽·決賽[直播][普/粵]
programme.desc: 「王者榮耀」KPL十周年，兩支北京電競隊在年度總決賽狹路相逢，爭逐榮耀加冕！北京JDG戰隊一路由勝者組強勢推進，明星選手無畏、清融是致勝關鍵。北京WB戰隊從敗者組逆襲而歸，打野暖陽、射手昭珏都是陣中核心。此外，表演嘉賓周深會以歌聲加持「榮耀」殿堂。TVB翡翠台、明珠台接力播映這場BO7大戰，主持張與辰、彭家賢、施焯日、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編黃瀅仴，聯同資深電競賽事評述員老星，跟觀眾迎接「王者」駕臨！

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport[Eng]
programme.desc: In this episode, a herd of African elephants get captured and loaded into transportation vehicles, ready to be moved to another area. Elephant populations have increased to a point where they are affecting the habitat in some of the nature reserves in South Africa. To alleviate the need for culling, translocation experts try to move them to new parks where there are no elephants.

programme.title: 動物宅急便[英]
programme.desc: 在南非一些動物保護區，非洲象數量上升到足以影響棲息地的程度，對其他物種構成威脅。為了避免撲殺大象去維持平衡，動物遷移專家團隊出動捕捉，把牠們送到其他沒有大象的地區生活。

programme.title: Maximum Foodie[Eng]
programme.desc: In this special episode, Sashi explores the breathtaking Seychelles, discovering its pristine beaches, unique wildlife, luxurious resorts, and rich cuisine. From learning to prepare the traditional octopus curry to enjoying freshly grilled lobster and red snapper, Sashi experiences the ultimate island luxury. Surrounded by spectacular scenery and exceptional seafood, this is definitely an unforgettable culinary adventure.

programme.title: 食盡全世界[英]
programme.desc: 薩希在今集特別篇去了迷人的塞舌爾，探索其原始海灘、獨特的野生動物、豪華度假酒店和豐富美食。從學做傳統的章魚咖喱到品嘗鮮烤龍蝦和紅魚，他體驗到終極的島嶼奢華享受，美景和海鮮，這絕對是難忘的美食歷險之旅。

programme.title: 笑笑小電影[英]

programme.title: DownieLive Travels by Train[Eng]
programme.desc: Mike and Will arrive in the last province, British Columbia. Last week, the final leg of the train was canceled due to extreme weather. They have to take the plane to BC, where they paddle with their family and learn more about the history and culture of the Tsleil-Waututh first nation. And they grab the chance to ice-skate. But will they complete the journey with the train?

programme.title: 貼地鐵路遊[英]
programme.desc: 今集，米高和韋爾來到最後一站：卑詩省。最後一段火車因極端天氣被取消，他們要坐飛機到卑詩省。他們跟親友一起划船，認識特斯利-沃圖原住民的歷史和文化，還把握機會在溫哥華溜冰。他們最後能否坐火車完成旅程？

Witness the artistry of fresh scallop sashimi and savour the exquisite flavours of a sweet rice pudding with salted caramel.

programme.desc: 改編自漫威漫畫角色,特技摩托車手強尼·布雷斯獻出靈魂成為地獄復仇者,迎戰魔王之子——野心勃勃的黑心魔.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: When a covert mission goes wrong, a soldier escapes—leaving his best friend in enemy hands. A year later, he risks it all on a pulse-pounding rogue rescue! Thomas Ian Griffith stars in this explosive, adrenaline-fueled tale of ultimate loyalty.

programme.title: 1997衝出封鎖線
programme.desc: 在一場秘密任務失敗後,一名士兵幸運逃脫,卻不得不將摯友留在敵人手中.一年後,他冒著失去一切的風險,展開了一場扣人心弦的單槍匹馬救援行動!由湯瑪斯·伊恩·格里菲斯(Thomas Ian Griffith)主演,這是一部充滿爆發力與腎上腺素飆升的終極忠誠傳奇.

programme.title: Mr. Mrs. Smith
programme.desc: A bored married couple discovers they are both elite assassins working for competing agencies—and their next assignment is to eliminate each other. Marriage counseling just got explosive.

programme.title: 史密斯任務
programme.desc: 一對感到厭倦的夫妻意外發現兩人竟是效力於競爭機構的頂尖殺手,而他們的下一個任務,就是除掉對方.這場婚姻諮商頓時火藥味十足.

programme.title: Maximum Risk
programme.desc: In Maximum Risk, Jean-Claude Van Damme investigates his twin brothers death, leading him from France to New York alongside his brothers girlfriend (Natasha Henstridge) as they flee Russian mobsters and expose an international conspiracy.

programme.title: 極度冒險
programme.desc: 在《全力反彈》中,尚-克勞德·范·達美調查雙胞胎兄弟的死因,並與兄弟的女友(娜塔莎·韓絲翠 飾)一同從法國追查到紐約,在逃避俄羅斯黑幫追殺的同時揭開一場國際陰謀.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

programme.title: 黑色九月
programme.desc: 這部現代動作驚悚片圍繞著前中央情報局(CIA)探員尼克·蘭道(Nick Randall)展開.現為賞金獵人的他受僱追查一名殘暴的國際恐怖分子,以阻止其計畫在洛杉磯發動毀滅性的化學武器攻擊.

programme.title: Widows
programme.desc: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

programme.title: 寡婦
programme.desc: 故事以動盪不安的當代芝加哥為背景,四個毫無共同點的女人,唯一的交集是她們已故丈夫因犯罪活動而留下的債務.她們決定掌握自己的命運,共同謀劃依據自己的方式開創未來.

programme.title: Enter The Game Of Death
programme.desc: In this martial arts adventure set on the eve of WWII, a skilled fighter is hired by Chinese espionage to fight his way up a multi-story tower and retrieve a top-secret military document detailing a planned invasion.

programme.title: 死亡遊戲
programme.desc: 這部以二戰前夕為背景的武術冒險電影,講述了一名身手不凡的格鬥家受僱於中國情報部門,一路闖關殺上多層高樓,旨在奪回一份記錄著入侵計畫的頂級軍事機密文件.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

programme.title: 移動世界
programme.desc: 一位男子意外發現自己擁有驚人的超能力,能瞬間移動到世界上任何他能想像到的地方,就此展開一段史詩般的冒險之旅.

programme.title: Fist From Shaolin
programme.desc: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之男兒當報國
programme.desc: 一名少林武者對抗販賣奴隸的惡勢力,誓要阻止同胞被賣往美洲金礦淪為苦役.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: The ultimate battle for existence begins! Armed with deadly aim, Roland the Last Gunslinger crosses realities to defend the mythical Dark Tower from the sinister Man in Black. If the tower falls, the universe crumbles into absolute darkness!

programme.title: 黑塔
programme.desc: 決定宇宙存亡的終極對決爆發!最後的槍客羅蘭跨越異次元,誓死抵禦黑衣人的邪惡侵襲.一旦黑暗塔倒塌,全宇宙將徹底陷入萬劫不復的深淵!

programme.title: White House Down
programme.desc: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

programme.title: 白宮末日
programme.desc: 當重裝雇傭兵圍攻白宮,一名面試特勤局失敗的特警必須衝破封鎖線,奮力營救總統、拯救被扣為人質的女兒,並阻止第三次世界大戰爆發.

programme.title: 回到未來 III
programme.desc: 在《回到未來 III》中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士.這部影片充滿了笑話、動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: 驚心妒怨
programme.desc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..

programme.title: Creepy Pasta
programme.desc: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

programme.title: Creepy Pasta
programme.desc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: 畫魔人
programme.desc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。

programme.title: Malee
programme.desc: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

programme.title: Malee
programme.desc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: 秦明·生死語者
programme.desc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

programme.title: Apartment 212

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 看不見的他們
programme.desc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…

programme.title: 3 Demons
programme.desc: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

programme.title: 3 Demons
programme.desc: 副警長James奉命看守一具曾舉行神秘儀式的女屍。豈料,他因一時好奇誤觸未完成的邪惡儀式,讓禁忌之門大開,釋放出三個黑暗惡魔。在精神廢墟、幻覺與真實邪祟的瘋狂夾擊下,他的理智逐步瓦解,最終墜入無法逃離..

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. programme.title: Waning Moon

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #26 [粵]
programme.desc: 風及芝等為慶祝琛成為Training Captain，特意在家中開派對玩樂，宏帶來了已和芝分手的沛。Cadet Program在開始進入模擬飛行訓練前，琛卻先安排學員以單車模擬飛行及降落，讓他們了解困難所在。琛意識到風對晨有愛意後，竟直接向晨提出約會的請求，琛為與晨的約會而製作蛋糕，希見狀也要求琛教她，並不斷追問是要做給誰人。琛特意帶晨和認識怡的同事見面，晨亦請了琛回家傾談，兩人了解加深。希不斷試探琛，但琛毫無反應，突然琛在房門外用二胡演奏生日歌，希大感驚喜……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #27 [粵]
programme.desc: 駿想邀請麟和娉前往三亞為Skylette的客戶拍攝廣告，麟找了雄同行，而娉也偕嘉一起出發。芝誤會麟向眾人透露自己懷孕的秘密，之後芝找麟痛罵。眾人在三亞海灘拍攝時，娉一直心不在焉，與駿的對話卻是每句都帶刺。駿向嘉說出自己曾離婚的往事，回到酒店後竟收到花籃及心意卡，署名竟然是女兒的名字。Cadet Program開始教導模擬飛行，空中服務員訓練則開始示範機艙服務程序。麟自知本身英文能力不足，便努力將勤補拙，得到琛的讚賞。芝終發現誤會了麟，為了道歉便特意請麟一起吃飯……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #28 [粵]
programme.desc: 風收到通知，得悉機長試是由琛負責評核。琛再次約會晨，但卻設計特意給風撞破。風得知琛心思後，專誠往停機坪找晨，並將自製的手繩送給晨。風因為機長試而坐立不安，陽發現後約風遊車河並開解他。風聽從陽的意見不強迫自己溫習，但琛覺得弟弟沒有危機感。風陪伴芝做產前檢查，卻因此知道思患上了不治之症。風正式進入最後的駕駛測試，而琛負責從後觀察風的飛行。思為了支持風，也特地乘坐風負責的航班，順道回台灣探親並見證他完成機長試，但飛行途中思卻病發昏迷……

programme.title: A Chip Off The Old Block #21 [Can]
巴不得爸爸... #21 [粵]
programme.desc: (大結局)慈目睹自己曾經說出不少傷害帆的說話，亦明白帆一直阻止自己和棉見面的原因；帆喜見慈出現在眼前，以為成功阻止他回到過去，慈則解釋自己是再次回到2008年，使棉認定自己成為城中富豪乃天命。慈憶起金魚店那個和芬長得一樣的女孩，遂向帆打探她的過去。帆告知自慈突然失蹤後，芬亦在風水里消失，眾人認定他們私奔。慈問及那女孩的身世，並認出自己的手機時，她卻否認自己是芬……慈協助帆收拾泉的遺物時發現一個保險箱，慈憶起泉臨終時所說的數字，終解開帆心中的遺憾，慈亦因此得悉自己的身世。

programme.title: 叛逃 #1 [粵]
programme.desc: 日本恐怖分子佐藤，與東非恐怖分子談判破裂，被休班警員莊有傑擊退。有傑見其兄有打架鬧事，原來有正加入黑狗社團當手下，受委託殺佐藤。有傑母唐淑芬見有正欲殺佐藤制止。ATF掌握佐藤地點，派出特種部隊拘捕他。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #1 [粵]

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #2 [粵]

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #28 [粵]
programme.desc: 風收到通知，得悉機長試是由琛負責評核。琛再次約會晨，但卻設計特意給風撞破。風得知琛心思後，專誠往停機坪找晨，並將自製的手繩送給晨。風因為機長試而坐立不安，陽發現後約風遊車河並開解他。風聽從陽的意見不強迫自己溫習，但琛覺得弟弟沒有危機感。風陪伴芝做產前檢查，卻因此知道思患上了不治之症。風正式進入最後的駕駛測試，而琛負責從後觀察風的飛行。思為了支持風，也特地乘坐風負責的航班，順道回台灣探親並見證他完成機長試，但飛行途中思卻病發昏迷……

programme.title: A Chip Off The Old Block #21 [Can]
巴不得爸爸... #21 [粵]
programme.desc: (大結局)慈目睹自己曾經說出不少傷害帆的說話，亦明白帆一直阻止自己和棉見面的原因；帆喜見慈出現在眼前，以為成功阻止他回到過去，慈則解釋自己是再次回到2008年，使棉認定自己成為城中富豪乃天命。慈憶起金魚店那個和芬長得一樣的女孩，遂向帆打探她的過去。帆告知自慈突然失蹤後，芬亦在風水里消失，眾人認定他們私奔。慈問及那女孩的身世，並認出自己的手機時，她卻否認自己是芬……慈協助帆收拾泉的遺物時發現一個保險箱，慈憶起泉臨終時所說的數字，終解開帆心中的遺憾，慈亦因此得悉自己的身世。

programme.title: 叛逃 #1 [粵]
programme.desc: 日本恐怖分子佐藤，與東非恐怖分子談判破裂，被休班警員莊有傑擊退。有傑見其兄有打架鬧事，原來有正加入黑狗社團當手下，受委託殺佐藤。有傑母唐淑芬見有正欲殺佐藤制止。ATF掌握佐藤地點，派出特種部隊拘捕他。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #1 [粵]
programme.desc: 綽號「羅斌」的影樓老闆羅斌漢在機上遇到芳凝，更被她當成瘋狂粉絲。台灣富商賴哥頓發現神秘作家「馬祖蓮娜」竟是桑尚恆，尚恆說服哥頓以自己名義出自傳，由他代筆。芳凝向女兒南思坦言答應為哥頓演出全因為南思。

programme.title: 華麗轉身 #2 [粵]
programme.desc: 迪迪帶尚恆回酒店房親熱，但她看到芳凝的高跟鞋便清醒過來。芳凝在哥頓授勳慶祝會上獻唱，羅斌致電明霞讓她欣賞偶像的歌聲。芳凝得悉南思將結婚，想從社交網站看女兒的近況。尚恆哄迪迪高聲說出對男人的要求……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #26 [粵]
programme.desc: 風及芝等為慶祝琛成為Training Captain，特意在家中開派對玩樂，宏帶來了已和芝分手的沛。Cadet Program在開始進入模擬飛行訓練前，琛卻先安排學員以單車模擬飛行及降落，讓他們了解困難所在。琛意識到風對晨有愛意後，竟直接向晨提出約會的請求，琛為與晨的約會而製作蛋糕，希見狀也要求琛教她，並不斷追問是要做給誰人。琛特意帶晨和認識怡的同事見面，晨亦請了琛回家傾談，兩人了解加深。希不斷試探琛，但琛毫無反應，突然琛在房門外用二胡演奏生日歌，希大感驚喜……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #27 [粵]
programme.desc: 駿想邀請麟和娉前往三亞為Skylette的客戶拍攝廣告，麟找了雄同行，而娉也偕嘉一起出發。芝誤會麟向眾人透露自己懷孕的秘密，之後芝找麟痛罵。眾人在三亞海灘拍攝時，娉一直心不在焉，與駿的對話卻是每句都帶刺。駿向嘉說出自己曾離婚的往事，回到酒店後竟收到花籃及心意卡，署名竟然是女兒的名字。Cadet Program開始教導模擬飛行，空中服務員訓練則開始示範機艙服務程序。麟自知本身英文能力不足，便努力將勤補拙，得到琛的讚賞。芝終發現誤會了麟，為了道歉便特意請麟一起吃飯……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #29 [粵]
programme.desc: 風得悉思因病昏迷後大為緊張，更漠視副機長力的意見，務求飛機能準時降落，結果風的機長考試宣佈失敗。晨尋找風，但風卻因落第而沒有向晨表明心意。風為了滿足思的心願，便陪她一起看日落。風打算為晨製造驚喜，藉此向她表露心跡而通宵達旦，但結果在陰差陽錯之下，反令思誤會了風對自己有愛意。宏亦開始預備機長試，整天苦讀後的他遇上了嘉，兩人一起進餐及逛水族店。思來到了琛家找風，想為他演奏牧童笛，琛見狀拿出二胡伴奏，以圓思心願，但是不知就裡的希竟提出要加入……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #30 [粵]
programme.desc: 希和琛及一眾同事聚首玩紙牌遊戲消遣，看到希對琛的互動和親暱，不禁讓大家都感到兩人關係甚親密。陽在Skylette的門外，遇見到一位年輕的女支持者詩，她要求陽協助她完成報告作業並帶她遊覽Skylette。陽介紹了晨給詩認識，三人在飯局的言談間，晨發現詩可能就是自己身在法國的同父異母妹妹。Cadet Program開始模擬飛行練習，麟憑之前努力得到高度評價，相反當夢和希出現嚴重失誤。因為只有夢被召見，其他的學員覺得琛偏袒希，這些說話卻傳到琛耳中，令琛決定與希保持距離。

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #31 [粵]
programme.desc: 東、駿等人在酒吧巧遇心，琛趁機將心的心意告訴東。空中服務員正式在航班中實習，駿支持娉特地出現，並為她唱生日歌，駿更在眾人的面前承認娉是自己親生女兒。駿邀請嘉在台灣約會，但是嘉和宏偷偷離開酒店以避開駿，嘉和宏之後更發生親密關係。琛與希吵架，之後琛更向小儀討教自己應否追求希。琛故意同時邀約晨及風一起下班，希望能幫忙修補他們之間緊張的關係，但無功而回。琛與晨見面，並將緣分天使送給她。雄、麟、泰及希成績特別出眾，被東公開表揚。

programme.title: 叛逃 #2 [粵]
programme.desc: 有正與同黨打算與黑狗會合，有傑尾隨被擒。東非恐怖分子利用解碼器進行不法勾當，有正向ATF報訊，原來他是臥底探員。兄弟探淑芬，淑芬知有正身分如釋重負。有正遇日嘉，被她吸引。指揮官沈志敖邀有正加入ATF。

programme.title: 叛逃 #3 [粵]
programme.desc: 有傑對日嘉一見鍾情，成功考取入職ATF資格，與有正入營受訓。日嘉教授訓練生進營地，有傑與她見面格外緊張。有正利用木馬程式約日嘉。有正送別日嘉不成功，但知日嘉出身富貴人家。有正和有傑違反紀律被志敖發現。

programme.title: 公公出宮 #13 [粵]
programme.desc: 金家請法師到河邊超渡，希望找到振西屍體；晉昇助黃蓮洗衫時，一個玉佛鏈墜從黃蓮衣服中跌出來，晉昇覺得玉佛似曾相識。帶男經過賭坊時忍不住要賭錢，膽哥揚言要斬她的手，小鳳挺身保護帶男。帶弟吩咐黃蓮辦一連串事務，肅恭提點她卻發現帶弟懷孕秘密告訴金香。帶子以為肅恭誣衊帶弟把他推落河，證據被水溶掉。金昌召集所有人到米舖，指證大芝包養男人開假單報大數，還將姦夫押到。金香知道金昌又闖禍，因那男人正是大芝的兄長。

programme.title: 公公出宮 #14 [粵]
programme.desc: 帶弟成功要脅丹田助她滑胎卻暈倒，金昌等人終明白錯怪肅恭。肅恭夜靜難眠，卻聽見房外有腳步聲；他和金香、晉昇追出，發現黑影竟是振西。丹田制止帶弟做劇烈運動，規定她每天到醫館飲補藥，帶弟更協助丹田登記病人資料。大芝不准多寶到上海讀書，怕多寶一走，失去依靠。小鳳在街上撞見大芝與名震江湖的拐子佬名震江湖的拐子佬糾纏。大芝聞肅恭丟失多寶多寶，接着有人要她拿五千大洋贖多寶；金香指願出贖金，大芝願意前往交贖金……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #29 [粵]
programme.desc: 風得悉思因病昏迷後大為緊張，更漠視副機長力的意見，務求飛機能準時降落，結果風的機長考試宣佈失敗。晨尋找風，但風卻因落第而沒有向晨表明心意。風為了滿足思的心願，便陪她一起看日落。風打算為晨製造驚喜，藉此向她表露心跡而通宵達旦，但結果在陰差陽錯之下，反令思誤會了風對自己有愛意。宏亦開始預備機長試，整天苦讀後的他遇上了嘉，兩人一起進餐及逛水族店。思來到了琛家找風，想為他演奏牧童笛，琛見狀拿出二胡伴奏，以圓思心願，但是不知就裡的希竟提出要加入……

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #30 [粵]
programme.desc: 希和琛及一眾同事聚首玩紙牌遊戲消遣，看到希對琛的互動和親暱，不禁讓大家都感到兩人關係甚親密。陽在Skylette的門外，遇見到一位年輕的女支持者詩，她要求陽協助她完成報告作業並帶她遊覽Skylette。陽介紹了晨給詩認識，三人在飯局的言談間，晨發現詩可能就是自己身在法國的同父異母妹妹。Cadet Program開始模擬飛行練習，麟憑之前努力得到高度評價，相反當夢和希出現嚴重失誤。因為只有夢被召見，其他的學員覺得琛偏袒希，這些說話卻傳到琛耳中，令琛決定與希保持距離。

programme.title: 衝上雲霄II #31 [粵]
programme.desc: 東、駿等人在酒吧巧遇心，琛趁機將心的心意告訴東。空中服務員正式在航班中實習，駿支持娉特地出現，並為她唱生日歌，駿更在眾人的面前承認娉是自己親生女兒。駿邀請嘉在台灣約會，但是嘉和宏偷偷離開酒店以避開駿，嘉和宏之後更發生親密關係。琛與希吵架，之後琛更向小儀討教自己應否追求希。琛故意同時邀約晨及風一起下班，希望能幫忙修補他們之間緊張的關係，但無功而回。琛與晨見面，並將緣分天使送給她。雄、麟、泰及希成績特別出眾，被東公開表揚。

programme.title: 叛逃 #2 [粵]
programme.desc: 有正與同黨打算與黑狗會合，有傑尾隨被擒。東非恐怖分子利用解碼器進行不法勾當，有正向ATF報訊，原來他是臥底探員。兄弟探淑芬，淑芬知有正身分如釋重負。有正遇日嘉，被她吸引。指揮官沈志敖邀有正加入ATF。

programme.title: 叛逃 #3 [粵]
programme.desc: 有傑對日嘉一見鍾情，成功考取入職ATF資格，與有正入營受訓。日嘉教授訓練生進營地，有傑與她見面格外緊張。有正利用木馬程式約日嘉。有正送別日嘉不成功，但知日嘉出身富貴人家。有正和有傑違反紀律被志敖發現。

programme.title: 公公出宮 #13 [粵]
programme.desc: 金家請法師到河邊超渡，希望找到振西屍體；晉昇助黃蓮洗衫時，一個玉佛鏈墜從黃蓮衣服中跌出來，晉昇覺得玉佛似曾相識。帶男經過賭坊時忍不住要賭錢，膽哥揚言要斬她的手，小鳳挺身保護帶男。帶弟吩咐黃蓮辦一連串事務，肅恭提點她卻發現帶弟懷孕秘密告訴金香。帶子以為肅恭誣衊帶弟把他推落河，證據被水溶掉。金昌召集所有人到米舖，指證大芝包養男人開假單報大數，還將姦夫押到。金香知道金昌又闖禍，因那男人正是大芝的兄長。

programme.title: 金裝四大才子 #45 [粵]
programme.desc: 枝山想起石榴的恩情，與她成親。皇上將鳳姐安置在「豹房」。伯虎將思念秋香之情寫成故事，因畫不出秋香畫像而苦惱，在街上赫然發現畫有秋香穿上韃靼服畫像的絲絹。石榴為婚禮張羅，枝山卻借故將婚期押後，石榴大怒。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #7 [粵]
programme.desc: 龍復職後要下屬老姜給他看舊文件，發現大堆案件未破。龍發現姜的工作手法甚有問題，實行大改革，令警局人心惶惶。Ada被客人太太上門騷擾，瑩調停時被對方打傷。龍上門慰問瑩，亦告知是Ada的主意，龍細心幫瑩搽藥油，令瑩甜在心頭。瑩和Ada在時裝店遇上瑩表姑姐楚玉。玉對司機刻薄，令他憤然辭職。瑩向保求救，保聽到玉名字即時趕至。保介紹新當玉司機，新面試時感不是味兒並憤然離去。後因新救了玉的兒子，令玉堅持聘請他。龍到店舖找Ada，發現瑩穿上婚紗對鏡子傻笑。龍突送上鮮花，並跪地向瑩求愛。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #8 [粵]
programme.desc: 玉接獲恐嚇電話報警求助，龍到場調查。龍在警局巧遇如，向她申訴有一下屬工作態度很有問題，而姜亦向如訴苦，指上司對他處處針對。Ada舉行慈善拍賣會，龍到場支持，瑩感不是味兒。Ada告訴瑩確曾想過與龍發展，但前任男友望與她舊情復熾，她最終亦選擇和對方一起，但與龍仍是好朋友。新接玉兒子放學，突然被綁匪包圍，幸龍等人及時趕至，終將眾人繩之於法。龍告訴玉，綁匪指是其夫欠下一筆巨債，玉不肯相信。步姐和蝦餃代瑩相約龍，還在商場的廣告版登示愛廣告，龍到了現場亦不敢出現。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #3 [粵]
programme.desc: 拜堂日同逃去，閏等他回來。同自薦入武學堂，泰為挫洵收同。摩巴結同，同不屑。揚對五苛刻，五反感。同、五投契，肝膽相照。揚對蘭冷淡，蘭更著迷。泰分學生為刀、槍組，刀組以摩為首。五找揚教刀法，揚先要考驗他。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #4 [粵]
programme.desc: 同向揚拜師，揚不允。洵巡武學堂，五得悉同身分。同以揚刀法與蘭交手，蘭決意七日後再比試。同求洵給他五年，洵條件是要與閏成親，閏提議做有名無實夫婦。五解破揚難題，揚教五等刀法。怡為五造重刀，摩辱五刀簡陋。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #76 [粵]
programme.desc: 山忽然像心臟病發般跌倒在地，恆要山學太極，山始終跟不上進度，鳳譏諷恆不懂教。鳳教山，果然山通過恆的考驗。恆跟蹤到山與上官鳳的約會，一言不合與鳳打了起來，山竟使出無極門的最終心法分開二人。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #77 [粵]
programme.desc: 公司正為一個廣告作錄音，藝人臨時失約，「扮聲之王」的華頂上。華暗戀的Karen揭破對哲有意，對華不屑一顧。廣告播出後大受歡迎，Karen主動向華搭訕，就連娜亦主動來拉攏他，哲勸華醒覺，華指責哲妒忌他。

programme.title: 同事三分親 #78 [粵]
programme.desc: 瑤的兄長昌需到內地公幹，要嵐替他照顧瑤，嵐含笑答應。彤參加了日本舉辦的Lolita選拔賽，但瑤即興的一曲，令她打消了參加比賽的決心。彤經哲多番鼓勵下，欲拿瑤的錄音去面試，哲往探望瑤時揭發此事的真相。

programme.title: 金裝四大才子 #45 [粵]
programme.desc: 枝山想起石榴的恩情，與她成親。皇上將鳳姐安置在「豹房」。伯虎將思念秋香之情寫成故事，因畫不出秋香畫像而苦惱，在街上赫然發現畫有秋香穿上韃靼服畫像的絲絹。石榴為婚禮張羅，枝山卻借故將婚期押後，石榴大怒。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #7 [粵]
programme.desc: 龍復職後要下屬老姜給他看舊文件，發現大堆案件未破。龍發現姜的工作手法甚有問題，實行大改革，令警局人心惶惶。Ada被客人太太上門騷擾，瑩調停時被對方打傷。龍上門慰問瑩，亦告知是Ada的主意，龍細心幫瑩搽藥油，令瑩甜在心頭。瑩和Ada在時裝店遇上瑩表姑姐楚玉。玉對司機刻薄，令他憤然辭職。瑩向保求救，保聽到玉名字即時趕至。保介紹新當玉司機，新面試時感不是味兒並憤然離去。後因新救了玉的兒子，令玉堅持聘請他。龍到店舖找Ada，發現瑩穿上婚紗對鏡子傻笑。龍突送上鮮花，並跪地向瑩求愛。

programme.title: 通天幹探 #8 [粵]
programme.desc: 玉接獲恐嚇電話報警求助，龍到場調查。龍在警局巧遇如，向她申訴有一下屬工作態度很有問題，而姜亦向如訴苦，指上司對他處處針對。Ada舉行慈善拍賣會，龍到場支持，瑩感不是味兒。Ada告訴瑩確曾想過與龍發展，但前任男友望與她舊情復熾，她最終亦選擇和對方一起，但與龍仍是好朋友。新接玉兒子放學，突然被綁匪包圍，幸龍等人及時趕至，終將眾人繩之於法。龍告訴玉，綁匪指是其夫欠下一筆巨債，玉不肯相信。步姐和蝦餃代瑩相約龍，還在商場的廣告版登示愛廣告，龍到了現場亦不敢出現。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #3 [粵]
programme.desc: 拜堂日同逃去，閏等他回來。同自薦入武學堂，泰為挫洵收同。摩巴結同，同不屑。揚對五苛刻，五反感。同、五投契，肝膽相照。揚對蘭冷淡，蘭更著迷。泰分學生為刀、槍組，刀組以摩為首。五找揚教刀法，揚先要考驗他。

programme.title: 鍾馗傳說 #14 [普]
programme.desc: 鍾馗是中國民間傳說中驅鬼辟邪之神，從古至今，鍾馗打鬼捉妖的故事幾乎人人熟知，足見鍾馗在民間的影響極為深廣。據古籍記載，鍾馗被唐玄宗敕封為“驅魔大神”，遍行天下“斬妖驅邪”；又被玉皇大帝敕封為專管凡塵...

programme.title: 衛子夫 #27 [普]
programme.desc: 參照《史記》、《漢書》相關記載，講述漢武帝的第二任妻子衛子夫的人生經歷。她出身卑微，入宮後生下長子劉據，成為漢武帝劉徹的第二任皇后。她只是一介平民歌女，沒有嬌豔媚態，沒有顯赫家勢，但卻憑著睿智蘭心...

programme.title: The Legend of the Condor Heroes #40 [Man]
射鵰英雄傳 #40 [普]
programme.desc: 由江南七怪調教而學得一身武藝的郭靖，得蒙古大汗成吉思汗賞識封為「金刀駙馬」。郭靖承母命下江南追尋殺父仇人，並往嘉興赴約比武，途中偶遇偽裝成乞丐的桃花島島主東邪的女兒黃蓉，從此結下不解之緣...
